title: El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron

info.about: El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron is a 2011 action video game developed by Ignition Tokyo and published by UTV Ignition Games for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It saw later releases on Windows and Nintendo Switch, with a PlayStation 5 port planned for later release.
info.trivia: Several of its staff were veterans of the then-defunct Clover Studio, alongside recruits from Square Enix and Sony.
info.why: It was the only game Ignition Tokyo completed before the studio closed in March 2011, and its planned sequels were abandoned.
